# Fact-check rules for this site

This site isn't flagged as YMYL. Factual claims still need a source; claims in the topics below need an approved source checked during the run.

## Claims that must be verified live

Toxicity of plants to pets or children; any claim about plant species' needs that goes beyond common care-guide consensus.

## Approved sources (fetch during the run, cite inline)

- ASPCA toxic and non-toxic plants list: https://www.aspca.org/pet-care/animal-poison-control/toxic-and-non-toxic-plants (for: pet toxicity)
- University extension services (.edu): https://extension.umn.edu/ (for: species care requirements)

## Extra rules from the owner

Name the specific plant when giving watering advice; never give one interval for 'all plants'.
